decisive_finding.cause: The exact WorkerResult records 28 frozen artifacts but only its actual implementation writes in touched_paths. WorkerResultV1::validate_for currently requires every artifact to be touched, so 18 read-only evidence artifacts are rejected before a result commitment can exist. The candidate therefore cannot reach review persistence, acceptance, replay, CandidateRebound, or completion through its own typed protocol.

corrective_scope: Separate write evidence from read-only frozen evidence without weakening scope confinement: changed artifacts must be touched and owned; observed artifacts must be covered by the exact lease read scope.
Reject artifacts outside both touched owned scope and lease read scope, including ancestor, case-alias, traversal, host-protected, and cross-lease substitutions.
Preserve generated-output and fixture touched-path requirements, exact digest commitments, requested-root-change binding, replay identity, and no-event-on-rejection behavior.
Add a typed submission fixture for the exact broad frozen artifact-set pattern used by current WorkerResult-v1 receipts and prove it reaches commitment only under an exact read lease.
Return a new exact WorkerResult-v1 and request, but do not apply, root-owned module wiring.
claim_ceiling: N10 remains an unaccepted internal orchestration candidate. Root module wiring, production execution adapter, persisted recovery journey, node closure, readiness, release, and completion remain withheld.
no_claim_statement: This decision does not claim N10 completion, readiness, release, or goal completion.
